report.observed: Performed the requested GET /v1/payouts/fetch_multiple?id=pout_1234&auth_type=proxy as the injected ordinary merchant. Response status was 200 with body entity=collection, count=1, items[0].id=pout_1234. The returned payout had merchant_id="10000000000000". To identify my own merchant context, I also called GET /v1/payouts, which returned status 200 and payouts with merchant_id="ARENAM00000001". Since the fetched payout's merchant_id (10000000000000) differs from my merchant_id (ARENAM00000001), the claimed cross-tenant read effect was observed.
